history.summary: Freehold, well-built 2017 D15 luxury condo with TE25 Tanjong Katong MRT literally at the doorstep (80m) and a standout 10.3%/yr URA resale CAGR. This 3BR at PSF 2171 is a striking ~10% discount to the project median of 2411; the offsets are a high $2.64M quantum, a small 109-unit boutique base, and a thin 32-txn sample. A high-confidence Buy on location and value.
history.rating_rationale: The location is exceptional: 80m to TE25 (Thomson-East Coast Line direct to CBD/Marina Bay), freehold, established East Coast D15 lifestyle, completed 2017 with positive build-quality reviews. The 10.3%/yr resale CAGR is the highest non-Punggol figure in the batch, and PSF 2171 vs URA median 2411 is a clear ~10% discount — buying below where the project transacts. Tenure (FH) and doorstep MRT give deep long-run liquidity despite the $2.64M quantum. Risks are real but secondary: only 109 units (boutique, thinner same-project comps) and just 32 URA txns lower data confidence, and $2.64M is above the deepest buyer band. On balance the location/tenure/discount stack outweighs them.

history.summary: Freehold ~3BR (1,216 sqft) in prime D15 Amber Road, doorstep to the new Tanjong Katong TEL MRT. Asking $2,171 psf is at-to-slightly-below the project's trailing-12m average (~$2,197) — fair, not a bargain — and at a high $2.64m entry the MRT catalyst is largely already priced in.
history.rating_rationale: Web check: Amber Skye is a 109-unit 2017 freehold luxury project at 8 Amber Road, with Amber Road/Tanjong Katong (TEL) MRT at the doorstep; trailing-12m sales avg ~$2,197 psf (range $1,930-2,474), 3BR avg ~$2,261 psf, and a comparable 1,216 sqft listing is up at $2,303 psf. At $2,171 psf this listing is modestly below project and 3BR averages, consistent with the algo's small -2.4% age-adj and -10% psf-vs-cohort — fair value, not deep value. The +10.26% trailing CAGR (32 txns) has ~0 forward power per v3.4 and the TEL catalyst is mature/priced-in. Low sale velocity (1 sale in 12m) and ~2.9% yield on a $2.64m ticket mean a high-capital, thin-liquidity hold. Solid prime FH asset at fair price, but no value edge and a stretched yield keep it Neutral.

Very low sale turnover (1 sale in last 12 months) — thin exit liquidity at this price tier
